Subject: Short notice: can we tighten demo to match VP + CTO window?

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the open slot tomorrow. We're trying to align both our VP of Product (Sara Holt) and CTO (Rakesh Menon) on the call — the VP can join most of the afternoon, but Rakesh is travelling and only has one compact window in the morning, roughly 11:15–11:45 PT.

Would it be possible to compress the walkthrough to a 30-minute exec-focused slot that covers the high-level value props and the integration milestones? I attached a quick availability grid (Exec-availability.xlsx) that shows their calendars. If you can offer a 11:15–11:45 PT option (or a 11:00–11:30 PT fallback), we can make it happen.

High-level ask for the compressed slot:
- 5 min intros + objectives (what they need to come away with)
- 15 min targeted demo for VP/CTO concerns (security, latency, deployment options)
- 10 min Q&A + next steps and mutual action items

Marko from procurement is on the thread to keep procurement timelines aligned; we may need a short SOW follow-up if the execs like what they see.

Appreciate a quick check — we only realized the overlap today.

Best,
Emma Lin
Head of Platform Integrations
Luminate Health
